title: Neon Drift Circuit
tagline: Drift the neon, charge the boost, out-run five rivals under a giant synthwave sun.
pitch: Neon Drift Circuit: a synthwave arcade kart racer at night. Drift through glowing neon corners, charge drift boosts, hit boost pads and race five rivals over three laps on a track lined with glowing palm trees and a giant setting sun. Pumping synth music, a slick sci-fi HUD with speedometer, lap counter and position.
controls: W / up: throttle, S / down: brake
Space (hold while steering): drift, release = boost

plan.title: Neon Drift Circuit
plan.tagline: Drift the neon, charge the boost, out-run five rivals under a giant synthwave sun.
plan.core_loop: Steer the kart around a neon night circuit, hold drifts in corners to charge nitro, ride boost pads and grab Volt Orbs, then release the boost to overtake rivals across three laps.
controls: Space: hold to drift, release for boost
plan.win_condition: Finish 3 laps in 1st place ahead of the five rivals (placement shown on the win screen).
plan.lose_condition: Finish the race in 5th or 6th place.
plan.art_direction: Synthwave palette: deep indigo night, hot magenta and cyan neon, a giant striped setting sun bleeding orange-pink on the horizon. Glossy black asphalt with glowing grid lines, chrome-and-plastic karts, palm trees rim-lit in pink, soft bloom on every light source. References: OutRun, Synthwave '84, retro-futurist arcade cabinets.
concept_shots: Low chase cam behind the player's cyan kart drifting a glowing hairpin — magenta tire smoke, speed lines, a grid of boost pads ahead, and the giant striped sun sinking behind the horizon.
Start grid at dusk: six karts lined up on the neon start line, palm trees glowing pink along both sides of the track, checkered banner and a 3-2-1 countdown over the sci-fi HUD.
Victory moment: the kart crosses the finish line in 1st place as confetti bursts, a big '1ST' banner and trophy icon flash on the HUD with the synth fanfare.

result.summary:
Neon Drift Circuit: a synthwave arcade kart racer built on the neon_night look. The player's cyan/magenta kart races 5 AI rivals over 3 laps on a medium race_track under a giant striped setting sun, with 24 Volt Orbs (10 to target), boost pads, drift-boost, and a full sci-fi HUD.

Built from the scaffold by adding the plan's features:
- Level: race_track (medium, seed 7) with collectibles retagged 'orb'; decorative generated props (neon palms + boost pylons) placed along the route on the ground.
- Player: kart with body #00f0ff / accent #ff2d95, chase camera.
- Rules: 3 laps, 5 opponents, countdown, collect target 10, goal, count-up timer; onWin fires confetti + star burst + white flash, onLose fires a magenta flash.
- UI: scifi HUD with Volt Orb counter (generated orb icon), timer, lap, live position (gold/silver/bronze), km/h speedometer, minimap, and objective "Finish 3 laps in 1st place". Title screen sells the fantasy with tagline + control credit and a 3-2-1-GO countdown.
- Custom juice: cyan boost trail on the kart, magenta tire smoke + speed lines on drift, shockwave ring + speed lines + boost SFX on boost, sparkle burst + collect SFX on pickup, lap banners + chime (with a "FINAL LAP!" warning banner), and overtake/slip position toasts. Slow-mo + speed lines trigger on the final lap's finish straight.
- FX.auto + Audio.auto wire the rest (collect/checkpoint/damage/win/lose sounds and effects); Debug.install retained and game ends with game.start().

Verified via play_game (multiple runs): zero console errors, player moves along the route, collects orbs (21/24 in a 25s autopilot), races the rivals, and the position toasts fire.
changes: Retagged level collectibles to 'orb' (Volt Orbs, target 10)
Placed generated neon-palm and boost-pylon props along the route
Configured race rules: 3 laps, 5 AI opponents, countdown, count-up timer, onWin/onLose callbacks
Built scifi HUD: orb counter w/ generated icon, timer, lap, position, km/h speedometer, minimap, objective
Title screen with tagline, controls credit and 3-2-1-GO countdown
Added custom FX: cyan boost trail, magenta drift smoke, boost shockwave ring, collect sparkles, lap/final-lap banners, overtake/slip toasts, final-lap slow-mo
Wired generated SFX (boost, collect, checkpoint) on the matching events
known_issues: Autopilot tends to bunch up near the finish on the final lap, so a full 3-lap win was not observed in the 25s test window (race still in progress, no errors); the win/lose screens are wired via rules callbacks + FX.auto and will fire on completion.
Slow-mo on the final-lap finish straight is approximated by the last checkpoint rather than exact route progress.
